audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart handed Vayne levels 2, 3 and the first-item row while every corresponding 'why' on the page describes Sylas winning those stages, and the matchup is a 56.5% win rate for Sylas over 719 games. Packet levelChart reads Vayne, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Vayne.
audit.why: Vayne owns level 1 (free autos, no gap-close to answer). From level 2 Sylas has E1/E2 plus the W heal against a kit with zero sustain; Vayne only retakes the lead once Silver Bolts true damage scales past healing.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned to Vayne, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Vayne in both layers, with ratings rescaled to match.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: level 2 E, level 6 Hijack of Final Hour, Riftmaker, and Vayne's 2+ item Silver Bolts takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Condemn cooldown was quoted as 14 seconds as though that were the lane number; 14s is rank 4, and rank 1 is 20s. The late-game text claimed stealing Final Hour makes Vayne 'lose her steroid entirely for its duration' — Sylas's R copies an ultimate, it does not strip the owner's. Tumble's auto-attack reset, the actual tell that her burst has started, was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: A 20-second Condemn in the early levels is a far bigger window than 14, and it is the window Sylas's whole all-in schedule keys off. The stolen-ult claim would make a player commit to a fight expecting Vayne to be de-powered.
audit.corrected: Condemn stated at 20 seconds at rank 1; stolen Final Hour described as your own copy on her 100-second cooldown; Tumble named as an auto-reset whose wind-up is the cue to step back.
sources: _kits/vayne.json E cd 20/18/16/14/12, R cd 100/85/70, Q autoReset

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 are your bully window. Full kit means every E hook is a real kill threat: chain Q-slow into E2, proc passive autos in the landing animation, then W for the execute heal. Keep tracking her Condemn cooldown — at 14 seconds it is the only thing that saves her — and only commit your E when you have seen it recently used or she is away from terrain. If she Tumbles sideways on your hook approach, use E1 dash only to close and save E2 for when she stops moving. Shove the wave, deny plates, and look for the all-in the moment she misteps.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 are your bully window. Full kit means every E hook is a real kill threat: chain Q-slow into E2, proc passive autos in the landing animation, then W for the heal. Keep tracking her Condemn — 20 seconds at rank 1, the only thing that saves her — and commit your E only when you have seen it spent or she is away from terrain. Her burst opens on a Tumble auto-reset, so step off on the wind-up rather than the cast, and save E2 for the moment she stops moving. Shove the wave, deny plates, and all-in the moment she missteps.

edits.before: At 6 steal Final Hour immediately — the invis and bonus AD are devastating on an AP bruiser who can already stick to her, and she loses her steroid entirely for its duration. Force the kill here; this is your cleanest window of the game. Into first item the W sustain still outpaces Silver Bolts provided you keep fights short enough that she cannot stack three autos repeatedly. At 2+ items respect her hard — Silver Bolts true damage ignores your healing entirely, and her kite with Galeforce or Guinsoo means you can no longer run her down safely. At that point play for teamfight angles, flank to hook her into your team, and let someone else absorb the Bolts stacks while you burst her from the side.
edits.after: At 6 steal Final Hour immediately — the AD and the Tumble invisibility are devastating on an AP bruiser who already sticks to her, and hers is a 100-second cooldown she cannot re-buy. Force the kill here; this is your cleanest window of the game. Into first item the W sustain still outpaces Silver Bolts provided you keep fights short enough that she cannot land three hits on you repeatedly. At 2+ items respect her hard — Silver Bolts true damage ignores your healing entirely, and her attack-speed kite means you can no longer run her down safely. At that point play for teamfight angles, flank to hook her into your team, and let someone else absorb the Bolts stacks while you burst her from the side.

edits.before: She cannot Tumble away faster than you can chain Q slow into passive autos — keep the pressure on and bank small HP leads for the level 6 all-in.
edits.after: She cannot Tumble away faster than your Q slow into passive autos, and Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — bank small HP leads for the level 6 all-in.
